newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial wins bank charter approval.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial wins bank charter approval.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said Monday it received approval from the Office of the Comptroller of Currency to convert its federal savings bank subsidiaries into national banks.
TCF said the units involved are in Minnesota, Illinois, Wisconsin and Michigan. The company also won regulatory permission to charter new national banks in Ohio and Colorado.

The company is still awaiting approval from the Federal Reserve Board to form a bank holding company and from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp for federal deposit insurance for its new national banks in Ohio and Colorado.
The savings bank holding company's shares were trading down 1/8 Monday afternoon at 46-1/4.
